title: Bases and coordinates of finite tensor products with arbitrary basis index sets
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $J$ a finite set, and $M_j$ an $R$-module for each $j\in J$. For each $j$ let $(b_{j,i})_{i\in I_j}$ be a basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module], with $I_j$ arbitrary, possibly infinite or empty. Use the module tensor products [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. The pure tensors $b_{\alpha}=\bigotimes_{j\in J}b_{j,\alpha(j)}$, indexed by $\alpha\in\prod_{j\in J}I_j$, form an $R$-basis of $\bigotimes_{j\in J}M_j$. For $x_j\in M_j$, write $c_{j,i}(x_j)$ for the coefficient of $b_{j,i}$ in its finite basis expansion. The coefficient of $b_\alpha$ in $\bigotimes_jx_j$ is $\prod_{j\in J}c_{j,\alpha(j)}(x_j)$. For $J=\varnothing$ the tensor product is $R$, the product of index sets is a singleton and the displayed basis element is $1$.
